verdict: Paid ads paused; 45 leads this period with zero converted to appointments.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 45 leads from Meta at a cost of $10.19 per lead — an efficient rate by your own historical standard. However, Meta campaigns went dark on September 15 and have not run since, so no new paid leads have entered the pipeline in the past 10 days. The more pressing pattern is that all 45 leads produced zero booked appointments, pointing to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up on rather than a problem with the ads themselves. We are addressing the intake process directly, and the priority now is ensuring that when paid activity resumes, leads move through to appointments. Google Business Profile activity also softened this week and is being monitored closely.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from paid ads, at $10.19 each
appointments booked from 51 open opportunities in your pipeline
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period (calls, directions, website clicks)

watch_item.issue: Meta campaigns have been paused for 10 consecutive days, halting new lead flow.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reviewed for reactivation, with intake follow-up tightened first so the next leads are not lost.
